method: Identical saved prompts, one sample per effort per monument. Same model and provider, no reference images or repairs to xhigh outputs. Response cap increased from 11,000 to 32,000 tokens; all generations in both rounds ended with stop. Scores are subjective, using 40% recognizability, 30% visual finish, 20% framing and 10% working interaction. These paired samples suggest differences but do not establish statistical significance or isolate effort from the larger token cap.

results.prompt:
Build the Golden Gate Bridge with accurate structural hierarchy: two International Orange open-frame towers, a continuous road deck, paired sagging main cables and evenly spaced vertical hangers attached at both ends. Use a wide three-quarter viewpoint, cool ocean, distant hills and warm afternoon sun. Prioritize structural correctness over decoration.
